_doc: Prompts des animations des persos de Gordeka (pf_2d__animate), 2026-10-20, demande de Julien : mouvements exagérés et lisibles, mouvement de CHAQUE accessoire décrit pour chaque animation. Contrat pixelforge : le squelette Quaternius (`motion`) fait le mouvement du corps, le texte agit sur le visage, les détails et les éléments souples ; l'exagération passe par `mouvement` (exaggerate, bounce, arms, cycles) et les objets tenus par `hold`. Payload = motion + mouvement + description du perso + action (animation + allure + accessoires) + expression + tenue (mot simple pour SAM 3).
regles_communes: Side view facing right, exactly two legs and two feet in every frame (never a third foot or a ghost leg), the whole body stays inside the frame, feet on the same ground line except during jumps, smooth clean cartoon with the same thick dark navy outline as the reference image, same colors and proportions as the reference image in every frame, nothing added, nothing removed, accessories keep their exact shape and stay attached where they are on the reference. Strict side view facing right in every frame: the torso and the face never turn toward the camera. The body keeps the same shape and size as the reference in every frame, and rigid objects keep exactly their shape and size.

idle.action: Standing still, relaxed, gentle breathing (chest rises and falls slightly), one slow blink, tiny weight shift from foot to foot. Almost still, like a calm pause.
idle.expression: calm neutral face with a small content smile

walk.action: Happy bouncy trot of a child sneaking off to hide: springy little hops on each step, body bobbing clearly up and down, knees lifted high, arms swinging cheerfully, slight forward lean, a playful skip in the rhythm. Exaggerated, cartoon, joyful, never a calm adult walk.
walk.expression: mischievous sly smile, eyes squinting with fun, as if thinking 'I know the perfect hiding spot'

run_scared.action: Panicked cartoon sprint, running for dear life: very long strides, legs spinning fast, body leaning far forward, both arms flailing up in the air above the head, sweat drops flying off the head, a little dust puff at the heels. Hugely exaggerated, comic, never violent.
run_scared.expression: terrified comic face, eyes wide open, mouth open in a scream

hide_in.action: Dives into a hiding spot: quick crouch with squash, springy jump up and forward with stretch, then drops down out of the bottom of the frame head first, as if diving into a box. Ends with the character completely gone.
hide_in.expression: excited grin, then eyes shut tight while diving

hide_out.action: Pops out of a hiding spot: springs up from below the frame with a big stretch, arms up, lands with a little squash, then stands up straight and shakes off.

found.action: Being caught: huge startled jump straight up, feet leaving the ground, arms flung out, a big exclamation mark pops above the head, then lands and slumps down laughing, hand on the belly.
found.expression: shocked surprise with round eyes and open mouth, then laughing

trap.action: Sets a trap: looks left and right sneakily, crouches down, places a small object on the ground in front of him, pats it, stands back up rubbing his hands with glee.

trapped.action: Stuck in a sticky trap: feet glued to the ground, pulls hard on one leg then the other with both hands, body wobbling and stretching like rubber, arms windmilling for balance.

search.action: Rummages through a hiding spot: bent far forward, both arms digging fast in front, tossing imaginary things over the shoulder, head bobbing as if peeking inside.
search.expression: focused determined squint, tongue sticking out a little

detect.action: Listens and sniffs: cups one hand behind the ear, leans the head toward it, then sniffs the air with the nose raised, looks left then right with big eye movements.

extract.action: Reaches the exit: big jump of joy with both fists in the air, little spin, then runs off quickly out of the right side of the frame waving goodbye.

victory.action: Celebrates: repeated joyful jumps with both arms raised high, a fist pump at the top of each jump, little dance shuffle between jumps.

sad.action: Disappointed: shoulders drop, head hangs low, a slow big sigh (shoulders lift then sink), kicks a pebble lightly with one foot.
sad.expression: sad pout, eyes looking down, not crying

hunter_reveal.action: Becomes the hunter: pulls out a flashlight, shakes it twice, it switches on with a yellow beam pointing forward, then holds it up proudly in front of him.
hunter_reveal.expression: playful determined grin, one eyebrow raised

ghost.action: Floats gently in place: the whole body slowly bobs up and down in the air, feet dangling relaxed off the ground, the small white angel wings flap softly and slowly.
ghost.note: profil fantôme (perso + petites ailes d'ange) en image d'entrée ; le jeu le rend transparent et le fait flotter (choix de Julien, comme Louis) ; essai du préréglage pixelforge ghost (queue ondulante) en option
ghost.en_pause: Julien 2026-10-20 : fantômes générés annulés ; vol stationnaire + ailes par le code en attendant

ghost_move.action: Glides forward through the air: body leaning slightly forward, legs trailing behind relaxed, the small white angel wings flap clearly and steadily.
ghost_move.note: profil fantôme (perso + petites ailes d'ange) en image d'entrée ; le jeu le rend transparent et le fait flotter (choix de Julien, comme Louis) ; essai du préréglage pixelforge ghost (queue ondulante) en option

emote_rire.action: Laughs out loud: leans back, hand on the belly, shoulders shaking, little hops.
emote_rire.expression: eyes closed, mouth wide open laughing

emote_danse.action: Happy little dance: both arms stretched forward at shoulder height going up and down in turn, body swaying, head bobbing, small hops on the spot.
emote_danse.expression: laughing with joy, eyes closed, big open smile
emote_danse.en_pause: Julien 2026-10-20 : pas d'emotes aujourd'hui, prompts gardés

emote_pouce.action: Gives a big thumbs up toward the viewer with a little nod and a wink.

emote_chut.action: Shushes: puts one finger in front of the lips, leans forward slightly, looks left and right.

emote_langue.action: Teases: sticks out the tongue playfully, thumbs on the temples wiggling fingers, a little bounce.
emote_langue.expression: cheeky face with a big pink tongue sticking far out of the mouth, clearly visible in profile

louis.description: a little Basque boy with blond hair, a red beret, white short-sleeved shirt, red belt, navy rolled-up trousers

accessoires.defaut: stays firmly on the head, tilted the same way in every frame

par_animation.run_scared: the beret lifts slightly off the head and lands back
par_animation.found: the beret pops up above the head during the jump and lands back

txomin.description: a Basque lifeguard boy with dark brown skin, short black curly hair, black sunglasses, yellow tank top, red swim shorts, a silver whistle on a cord around his neck, a pair of blue swim fins hanging from his belt at his hip, barefoot

accessoires.objet: blue swim fins hanging from the belt at the hip
accessoires.defaut: stay hooked to the belt at the hip, swinging and flapping loosely with each step like a pendulum, never in his hands, never on his feet

par_animation.hide_in: follow the body into the hiding spot
par_animation.victory: bounce up and down with each jump

accessoires.objet: silver whistle on a cord around the neck
accessoires.defaut: hangs on the chest and bounces lightly with the body

par_animation.hunter_reveal: he blows the whistle once before pulling out the flashlight

accessoires.defaut: stay on the eyes in every frame

par_animation.found: slide down his nose during the startled jump

patxi.description: a bearded Basque fisherman with a blue beanie, yellow raincoat, navy trousers, black boots, a fishing rod strapped diagonally on his back

accessoires.objet: fishing rod strapped diagonally on the back
accessoires.defaut: stays rigid and fixed on the back at the same diagonal angle, moving only with the torso, never in his hands, the thin tip bends slightly with the motion

par_animation.run_scared: the tip whips back and forth
par_animation.hide_in: goes down with him, the tip last to disappear
par_animation.search: the tip wobbles as he rummages

accessoires.defaut: stays on the head

maia.description: a young Basque surfer girl with wet brown hair in a ponytail, deep turquoise wetsuit with a navy panel, a small yellow surfboard carried upright on her back with two shoulder straps, barefoot

accessoires.objet: small yellow surfboard strapped upright on the back
accessoires.defaut: stays strapped flat against her back, upright, moving only with the torso, never in front of her body, never in her hands

par_animation.run_scared: bounces against her back with each stride
par_animation.hide_in: she dives in, the board following her body
par_animation.trap: stays on her back while she crouches
par_animation.victory: bounces on her back as she jumps

accessoires.defaut: swings behind the head with the motion, with a little delay

xabi.description: a little Basque jai alai player boy with short dark brown hair, white polo shirt, white trousers, red sash belt, red espadrilles, a long curved wicker chistera basket worn on his right hand

accessoires.objet: long curved wicker chistera worn on the right hand
accessoires.defaut: stays attached to his right hand as an extension of the arm, keeps its long curved banana shape and its length in every frame, follows the right arm swing like a long glove, never detaches, never changes into a racket or a ball

par_animation.walk: swings forward and back with the right arm
par_animation.run_scared: flails up in the air with the right arm
par_animation.trap: he sets the trap with his free left hand, the chistera held aside
par_animation.search: he scoops with the chistera like a shovel

accessoires.defaut: the loose ends flutter behind at the hip

mattin.description: a strong Basque stone lifter man with a black beard, red beret, red and white horizontally striped shirt, navy trousers, brown shoes, big muscular arms

accessoires.defaut: stays firmly on the head

mattin.allure: heavy powerful moves: each step has weight, big arm swings, stomps when he lands

amaia.description: a Basque folk dancer girl with a red headscarf, green vest over a white blouse, red skirt, white espadrilles, a wooden makila walking stick slung diagonally on her back

accessoires.objet: wooden makila stick slung diagonally on the back
accessoires.defaut: stays rigid on her back at the same diagonal angle, moving only with the torso, never in her hands

accessoires.objet: red headscarf with knotted tails at the back of the head
accessoires.defaut: stays tied on the head, the two knot tails flutter behind with the motion

par_animation.victory: the tails flap up and down

accessoires.defaut: flares and swirls with each step like a dancer

amaia.allure: light dancer's steps, on her toes

kaio.description: a cheeky anthropomorphic seagull standing upright on two orange webbed feet, big yellow beak with a red dot, white head and belly, light grey wings used as arms with feathered fingertips, small grey tail, a small neckerchief scarf tied at the front

accessoires.objet: light grey wings used as arms
accessoires.defaut: behave like arms with feathered fingertips, swinging with the walk; they are not flying wings

par_animation.run_scared: flap frantically at his sides at shoulder height as if trying to take off, feet still running; he has no hands and no human arms, only his two grey wings
par_animation.found: fly up in surprise, a couple of feathers pop off

accessoires.defaut: wags with the waddle
stays tied in place, the two short tips flutter with the motion

kaio.allure: seagull waddle: body rocks side to side, webbed feet slap the ground, head bobs forward and back with each step

actions.run_scared: Panicked cartoon sprint, running for dear life: very long strides, webbed feet spinning fast, body leaning far forward, both grey wings flapping wildly at his sides, sweat drops flying off the head, a little dust puff at the heels. Hugely exaggerated, comic, never violent.

karramarro.description: a cheerful orange cartoon crab with thin legs, two big orange pincers raised, eyes on stalks, yellow belly, big happy open mouth, a small neckerchief scarf tied at the front

accessoires.defaut: held up, clacking open and shut with the rhythm
wobble with the motion, slightly delayed
all legs scuttle in a fast ripple, the crab keeps facing right
stays tied in place, the two short tips flutter with the motion

karramarro.allure: fast scuttling with all legs rippling, little hops

ramuntxo.description: a jolly Basque chef with light peach skin, a small brown mustache, tall white chef hat with a small Basque flag on its band, white chef jacket, red neck scarf, red and white checkered trousers, white apron, a black frying pan hanging from his belt

accessoires.objet: tall white chef hat with a small Basque flag on the band
accessoires.defaut: stays on the head, the soft top wobbles slightly, the flag stays on the band

par_animation.run_scared: the hat tilts back and wobbles hard
par_animation.found: the hat pops up and lands back

accessoires.objet: black frying pan hanging from the belt
accessoires.defaut: hangs from the belt at the hip and swings like a pendulum with each step, never in his hand

par_animation.trap: he unhooks the pan, sets a trap with it, then hooks it back
par_animation.search: bangs against his leg as he rummages

accessoires.objet: red neck scarf and white apron
accessoires.defaut: the scarf tips and the apron flutter lightly with the motion

ramuntxo.allure: jolly round bouncing walk, belly first

itsaso.description: a mythical girl made of sea water, pale cyan skin, long wavy aqua hair, a dress of deep blue waves edged with white sea foam, barefoot

accessoires.objet: dress made of deep blue waves edged with white foam
accessoires.defaut: the hem ripples continuously like rolling sea waves, foam curling at the edges, even when she stands still

par_animation.idle: gentle swell like a calm sea
par_animation.hide_in: she melts down into a splash of water
par_animation.hide_out: she rises up from a splash of water
par_animation.victory: waves splash up with each jump

accessoires.defaut: floats and flows as if underwater, slow and graceful

itsaso.allure: graceful gliding steps, as light as water; she is a magical sea creature

peio.description: a sturdy young Basque rugby player with medium brown skin and short black hair, red and white hooped rugby jersey, black shorts, white socks, black boots, a brown oval rugby ball tucked under his near arm

accessoires.objet: brown oval rugby ball under the near arm
accessoires.defaut: stays tucked tightly under his near arm against the ribs in every frame, never dropped, never floating

par_animation.run_scared: clutched tight to his chest with both arms like a try run
par_animation.trap: kept under the arm, he places the trap with his free hand
par_animation.victory: held high above his head with both hands
par_animation.found: he juggles it in surprise then catches it back
par_animation.emote_pouce: ball under the arm, thumbs up with the free hand
par_animation.emote_danse: stays tucked under the near arm, only the free arm dances

peio.allure: powerful rugby run, head forward, knees high
